n: τοῦ χριστοῦ· (tou christou) 'of the Christ;' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
πορνείᾳ, (porneia) 'sexual immorality' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)

Ἴδε (Ide) 'behold' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of Εἰ (Ei) 'If' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
καὶ ἐπὶ πάντας (kai epi pantas) 'and upon all' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
πατέρα (patera) 'father' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of προπάτορα (propatora) 'ancestor' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)

εἴ (ei) 'if' occurs in a few manuscripts (WH) instead of ἔτι (eti) 'Yet' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+Treg+TR+Byz)
ἔτι (eti) 'still' is only in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
τῷ κυρίῳ ἡμῶν.¶ (tō kuriō hēmōn) 'the Lord of us.' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
αὐτῇ ἐν (autēa en) 'it in' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
εὑρίσκω. (heuriskō) 'find.' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
εὐχαριστῶ (eucharistō) 'I thank' occurs in traditional manuscripts (Tyn+TR+Byz) instead of χάρις (charis) 'Thanks [be]' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+SBL+WH+Treg)
μὴ κατὰ σάρκα περιπατοῦσιν ἀλλὰ κατὰ πνεῦμα. (mē kata sarka peripatousin alla kata pneuma) 'not according to flesh walk but according to spirit.' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
με (me) 'me' occurs in traditional manuscripts (Tyn+Treg+TR+Byz) instead of σε (se) 'you' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+SBL+WH)

ἡμῶν (hēmōn) 'of us' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
Ἰησοῦς (Iēsous) 'Jesus' is only in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+WH)
οὖν (oun) 'then' is only in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+SBL)
ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ ὅτι λόγον συντετμημένον (en dikaiosunē hoti logon suntetmēmenon) 'in righteousness for word brought swiftly' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
νόμου· (nomou) 'of law;' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
πᾶς (pas) 'everyone' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
Ἰσραήλ (Israēl) 'of Israel' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of αὐτῶν (autōn) 'of them' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)

εἰρήνην τῶν εὐαγγελιζομένων (eirēnēn tōn euangelizomenōn) 'peace of those evangelising' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)

εἰ δὲ ἐξ ἔργων οὐκέτι ἐστὶν χάρις ἐπεὶ τὸ ἔργον οὐκέτι ἐστὶν ἔργον. (ei de ex ergōn ouketi estin charis epei to ergon ouketi estin ergon) 'if now from works no longer is grace since the work no longer is work.' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
οὖν (oun) 'therefore' is only in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
θεοῦ, (theou) 'of God,' is only in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
ἐπιμείνῃς (epimeinēs) 'they shall continue in' occurs in a few manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of ἐπιμένῃς (epimenēs) 'you shall continue in' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg+KJV)
νῦν (nun) 'now' is only in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+SBL+WH)
καιρῷ (kairō) 'time' occurs in a few manuscripts (TR) instead of κυρίῳ (kuriō) 'Lord' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg+Byz+KJV)
οὖν (oun) 'therefore' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of ἀλλ᾽ (all᾽) 'On the contrary' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
ἔργων (ergōn) 'works' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of ἔργῳ (ergō) 'work' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
οὖν (oun) 'therefore' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
οὐ ψευδομαρτυρήσεις, (ou pseudomarturēseis) 'not will you bear false witness' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR)

θεὸς (theos) 'God' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of κύριος (kurios) 'Lord' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)

καὶ ὁ μὴ φρονῶν τὴν ἡμέραν κυρίῳ οὐ φρονεῖ· (kai ho mē phronōn tēn hēmeran kuriō ou phronei) 'and the [one] not regarding the day to [the] Lord not regards [it];' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
καὶ ἀνέστη (kai anestē) 'and rose up' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
χριστοῦ (christou) 'Christ' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of θεοῦ. (theou) 'of God.' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
τούτοις (toutois) 'these things' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of τούτῳ (toutō) 'this thing' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
ἢ σκανδαλίζεται ἢ ἀσθενεῖ (ē skandalizetai ē asthenei) 'or is led into sin or is weak' is only in traditional manuscripts (Tyn+SBL+Treg+TR+Byz)
ἡμᾶς (hēmas) 'us' occurs in traditional manuscripts (WH+TR) instead of ὑμᾶς (humas) 'you' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+Treg+Byz)
Ἰησοῦν (Iēsoun) 'Jesus' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
ἐπαινέσατε (epainesate) 'you should praise' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of ἐπαινεσάτωσαν (epainesatōsan) 'they should praise' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
ἄλλους (allous) 'others' occurs in a few manuscripts (Byz) instead of ἀλλήλους (allēlous) 'one another' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg+TR)
ἁγίου (hagiou) 'holy' occurs in a few manuscripts (WH+Treg) instead of θεοῦ, (theou) 'of God,' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+TR+Byz)
ἱκανῶν (hikanōn) 'sufficient' occurs in a few manuscripts (SBL+WH+Treg) instead of πολλῶν (pollōn) 'many' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+TR+Byz)
ἐλεύσομαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς, (eleusomai pros humas) 'I will come to you' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
τοῦ εὐαγγελίου (tou euangeliou) 'of the gospel' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
ἵνα (ina) 'so that' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
Ἀχαΐας (Achaias) 'of Achaia' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of Ἀσίας (Asias) 'of Asia' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
ἡμᾶς (hēmas) 'us' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of ὑμᾶς.¶ (humas) 'you.' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
πᾶσαι (pasai) 'all' is only in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
Ἰησοῦ (Iēsou) 'Jesus' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
Χριστοῦ (Christou) 'Christ' is only in traditional manuscripts (SBL+Treg+TR+Byz)

Ἡ χάρις τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ μετὰ πάντων ὑμῶν. ἀμήν.¶ (Hē charis tou kuriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou meta pantōn humōn amēn) 'the grace of the Lord of us Jesus Christ with all of you. Amen.' is only in traditional manuscripts (SBL+TR+Byz)

πρός Ῥωμαίους ἐγράφη ἀπό Κορίνθου διὰ φοίβης τῆς διακόνου τῆς ἕν Κεγχρεαῖς ἐκκλησίας.¶ (pros Rhōmaious egraphē apo Korinthou dia phoibēs tēs diakonou tēs hen Kegchreais ekklēsias) 'to Romans it was written from Corinth through Phoebe the servant in Cenchrea church.' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR)
